title: MMedPO: Aligning Medical Vision-Language Models with Clinical Visual Preferences
method: Constructs plausible but visually inconsistent dispreferred responses and applies clinically weighted preference optimization
evidence: Targets lesion omission and visually unsupported medical statements
Uses parameter-efficient adaptation on a 7B medical VLM
Supports preference pairs as an intermediate stage after supervised alignment
limitations: Clinical relevance weights and visual confidence depend on external models/tools
Automatic preference generation can create circular validation
Reported improvements do not prove evidence causality
transfer_decision: Use grounded negative pairs, but derive primary labels from provenance-backed annotations and audit synthetic negatives manually.
